articles.summary: Loyalty leaders and their own customers don't always want the same things. We looked at some data taken from brand-side attendees who are registered to join The BIG Handshake Loyalty™ Chicago next month and compared it with Bond's 2026 Loyalty Report, and found five places where intent and reality diverge.
articles.title: 5 Loyalty Priorities. 4 Wrong Levers. 1 Missed Opportunity.
